questions.q: What is the IUPAC name of (CH₃)₂CHOH?
questions.explain: The carbon with –OH is C-2; so propan-2-ol (a secondary alcohol).

questions.q: Why is the boiling point of ethanol (351 K) higher than that of methoxymethane (248 K)?
options: Ethanol has a higher molecular mass
There is hydrogen bonding between ethanol molecules
questions.explain: Both have molecular mass 46 u; –OH forms hydrogen bonds, the ether does not.

questions.q: Which alcohol is obtained from propene by hydroboration–oxidation?
questions.explain: Hydroboration gives the anti-Markovnikov product — the primary alcohol.

questions.q: What is obtained after hydrolysis when the Grignard reagent CH₃MgBr reacts with acetone (CH₃COCH₃)?
questions.explain: A ketone gives a tertiary alcohol: (CH₃)₃C–OH.

questions.q: What is the by-product in the preparation of phenol from cumene?
questions.explain: Cumene hydroperoxide + dilute acid → phenol + acetone.

questions.q: Which of the following is the most acidic?
questions.explain: –NO₂ is electron-withdrawing and stabilises the phenoxide ion (pKₐ 7.1).

questions.q: Why is phenol more acidic than an alcohol?
options: The negative charge of the phenoxide ion is spread over the ring by resonance
Phenol has a higher molecular mass
questions.explain: Resonance stabilises the phenoxide ion, so the proton leaves easily.

questions.q: Which turns cloudy at once with the Lucas reagent at room temperature?
questions.explain: A tertiary alcohol reacts at once because of the stable carbocation.

questions.q: Which oxidising agent stops the oxidation of a primary alcohol at the aldehyde stage?
questions.explain: PCC is a mild oxidising agent; a primary alcohol stops at the aldehyde with it.

questions.q: What is obtained when phenol reacts with bromine water?
questions.explain: In bromine water all three ortho/para positions of phenol are substituted.

questions.q: What is obtained from phenol + NaOH, then CO₂ and H⁺?
questions.explain: This is Kolbe's reaction: 2-hydroxybenzoic acid (salicylic acid).

questions.q: What is the main product of tert-butyl bromide and CH₃ONa in the Williamson synthesis?
questions.explain: With a tertiary halide the alkoxide acts as a strong base and causes elimination.

questions.q: What is obtained when anisole is heated with HI?
questions.explain: The O–CH₃ bond breaks; the O–C₆H₅ bond does not because of its partial double bond character.
